items.source: Application code is required to retrieve the JDBC Connection via DataSourceUtils.getConnection(DataSource) instead of a standard EE-style DataSource.getConnection() call. Spring classes such as JdbcTemplate use this strategy implicitly. If not used in combination with this transaction manager, the DataSourceUtils lookup strategy behaves exactly like the native DataSource lookup; it can thus be used in a portable fashion.
items.translation: 应用程序代码需要通过 DataSourceUtils.getConnection(DataSource) 检索 JDBC Connection，而不是使用标准的 EE 风格 DataSource.getConnection() 调用。Spring 类（例如 JdbcTemplate）会隐式使用此策略。如果未与该事务管理器结合使用，DataSourceUtils 查找策略的行为与原生 DataSource 查找完全相同；因此，它可以以可移植的方式使用。

items.source: Supports custom isolation levels, and timeouts which get applied as appropriate JDBC statement timeouts. To support the latter, application code must either use JdbcTemplate, call DataSourceUtils.applyTransactionTimeout(Statement, DataSource) for each created JDBC Statement, or go through a TransactionAwareDataSourceProxy which will create timeout-aware JDBC Connections and Statements automatically.
items.translation: 支持自定义隔离级别和超时设置，后者将作为适当的 JDBC 语句超时进行应用。为了支持后者，应用程序代码必须使用JdbcTemplate，为每个创建的 JDBCStatement调用DataSourceUtils.applyTransactionTimeout(Statement, DataSource)，或者通过一个TransactionAwareDataSourceProxy，该代理会自动创建具有超时意识的 JDBCConnection和Statement。

items.source: Note: The DataSource that this transaction manager operates on needs to return independent Connections. The Connections typically come from a connection pool but the DataSource must not return specifically scoped or constrained Connections. This transaction manager will associate Connections with thread-bound transactions, according to the specified propagation behavior. It assumes that a separate, independent Connection can be obtained even during an ongoing transaction.
items.translation: 注意：此事务管理器操作的 DataSource 需要返回独立的 Connection。 Connection 通常来自连接池，但 DataSource 不得返回特定作用域或受限的 Connection。此事务管理器将根据指定的传播行为将 Connection 与线程绑定的事务关联起来。它假设即使在事务进行中也能获取到单独的、独立的 Connection。

items.source: Consider defining a LazyConnectionDataSourceProxy for your target DataSource, pointing both this transaction manager and your DAOs to it. This will lead to optimized handling of "empty" transactions, i.e. of transactions without any JDBC statements executed. A LazyConnectionDataSourceProxy will not fetch an actual JDBC Connection from the target DataSource until a Statement gets executed, lazily applying the specified transaction settings to the target Connection.
items.translation: 考虑为您的目标DataSource定义一个LazyConnectionDataSourceProxy，使该事务管理器以及您的 DAO 都指向它。这将导致对“空”事务（即未执行任何 JDBC 语句的事务）进行优化处理。LazyConnectionDataSourceProxy 不会从目标DataSource获取实际的 JDBC Connection，直到执行了Statement为止，从而懒式地将指定的事务设置应用到目标Connection。

items.source: The DataSource specified here should be the target DataSource to manage transactions for, not a TransactionAwareDataSourceProxy. Only data access code may work with TransactionAwareDataSourceProxy while the transaction manager needs to work on the underlying target DataSource. If there is nevertheless a TransactionAwareDataSourceProxy passed in, it will be unwrapped to extract its target DataSource.
items.translation: 此处指定的 `DataSource` 应为用于管理事务的目标 `DataSource``，而非一个 `TransactionAwareDataSourceProxy`。数据访问代码可与 `TransactionAwareDataSourceProxy` 交互，而事务管理器则需作用于底层的目标 `DataSource``。如果传入的仍然是 `TransactionAwareDataSourceProxy`，它将被解包以提取其目标 `DataSource``。

items.source: Alternatively, you can allow application code to work with the standard EE-style lookup pattern DataSource.getConnection(), for example for legacy code that is not aware of Spring at all. In that case, define a TransactionAwareDataSourceProxy for your target DataSource, and pass that proxy DataSource to your DAOs which will automatically participate in Spring-managed transactions when accessing it.
items.translation: 或者，您可以允许应用程序代码使用标准的 EE 风格查找模式 DataSource.getConnection()（例如，用于完全不了解 Spring 的遗留代码）。在这种情况下，为您的目标 DataSource 定义一个 TransactionAwareDataSourceProxy，并将该代理 DataSource 传递给您的 DAO；当访问它时，DAO 将自动参与 Spring 管理的事务。

items.source: The DataSource passed in here needs to return independent Connections. The Connections typically come from a connection pool but the DataSource must not return specifically scoped or constrained Connections, just possibly lazily fetched.
items.translation: 此处传入的DataSource需要返回独立的Connection。Connection通常来自连接池，但DataSource不能返回特定作用域或受限的Connection，仅可能延迟获取。

items.source: NOTE: As of 5.3, JdbcTransactionManager is available as an extended subclass which includes commit/rollback exception translation, aligned with JdbcTemplate.
items.translation: 注意：自 5.3 版本起，JdbcTransactionManager 作为扩展子类可用，包含提交/回滚异常翻译，与JdbcTemplate保持一致。

items.source: This will typically be a locally defined DataSource, for example a Hikari connection pool. Alternatively, you can also manage transactions for a non-XA DataSource fetched from JNDI. For an XA DataSource, use JtaTransactionManager instead.
items.translation: 这通常是一个本地定义的 `DataSource`，例如 Hikari 连接池。或者，您也可以管理从 JNDI 获取的非 XA `DataSource`` 的事务。对于 XA `DataSource``，请使用 JtaTransactionManager。

items.source: This transaction manager supports nested transactions via the JDBC Savepoint mechanism. The "nestedTransactionAllowed" flag defaults to "true", since nested transactions will work without restrictions on JDBC drivers that support savepoints (such as the Oracle JDBC driver).
items.translation: 此事务管理器通过 JDBC Savepoint 机制支持嵌套事务。"nestedTransactionAllowed" 标志的默认值为 "true"，因为对于支持保存点的 JDBC 驱动程序（例如 Oracle JDBC 驱动程序），嵌套事务可以不受限制地工作。

items.source: This transaction manager can be used as a replacement for the JtaTransactionManager in the single resource case, as it does not require a container that supports JTA, typically in combination with a locally defined JDBC DataSource (for example, a Hikari connection pool). Switching between this local strategy and a JTA environment is just a matter of configuration!
items.translation: 此事务管理器可用作单资源场景下对JtaTransactionManager的替代方案，因为它不需要支持 JTA 的容器，通常与本地定义的 JDBC DataSource（例如 Hikari 连接池）配合使用。在此本地策略与 JTA 环境之间切换仅需配置即可！

items.source: As of 4.3.4, this transaction manager triggers flush callbacks on registered transaction synchronizations (if synchronization is generally active), assuming resources operating on the underlying JDBC Connection. This allows for setup analogous to JtaTransactionManager, in particular with respect to lazily registered ORM resources (for example, a Hibernate Session).
items.translation: 自 4.3.4 版本起，此事务管理器会在注册的同步回调上触发刷新（如果同步处于活动状态），前提是底层 JDBC `Connection` 正在运行的资源。这使得配置类似于 `JtaTransactionManager``，特别是针对懒式注册的 ORM 资源（例如 Hibernate `Session`）。

items.source: The default implementation executes a "SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY" statement if the "enforceReadOnly" flag is set to true and the transaction definition indicates a read-only transaction.
items.translation: 默认实现会执行 "SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY" 语句，如果 `"enforceReadOnly"` 标志设置为true且事务定义指示为只读事务。

items.source: The exact treatment, including any SQL statement executed on the connection, can be customized through prepareTransactionalConnection(Connection, TransactionDefinition).
items.translation: 确切的处理方式，包括在连接上执行的任何 SQL 语句，都可以通过prepareTransactionalConnection(Connection, TransactionDefinition)进行自定义。

items.source: This mode of read-only handling goes beyond the Connection.setReadOnly(boolean) hint that Spring applies by default. In contrast to that standard JDBC hint, "SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY" enforces an isolation-level-like connection mode where data manipulation statements are strictly disallowed. Also, on Oracle, this read-only mode provides read consistency for the entire transaction.
items.translation: 这种只读处理模式超越了 Spring 默认应用的 Connection.setReadOnly(boolean)提示。与这种标准 JDBC 提示相反，"SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY"强制一种类似隔离级别的连接模式，其中严格禁止数据操作语句。此外，在 Oracle 上，此只读模式为整个事务提供读取一致性。

items.source: This target resource factory is usually used as resource key for TransactionSynchronizationManager's resource bindings per thread.
items.translation: 此目标资源工厂通常用作线程级资源绑定的资源键，用于 TransactionSynchronizationManager。

items.source: The default implementation throws a TransactionSystemException. Subclasses may specifically identify concurrency failures etc.
items.translation: 默认实现会抛出TransactionSystemException。子类可以具体识别并发失败等情况。

items.source: Note that older Oracle JDBC drivers (9i, 10g) used to enforce this read-only mode even for Connection.setReadOnly(true. However, with recent drivers, this strong enforcement needs to be applied explicitly, for example, through this flag.
items.translation: 请注意，旧版 Oracle JDBC 驱动程序（9i、10g）以前即使对于 `Connection.setReadOnly(true` 也会强制实施此只读模式。然而，在最近的驱动程序中，需要显式应用这种严格限制，例如通过此标志。

items.source:
The default implementation throws a TransactionSuspensionNotSupportedException,
assuming that transaction suspension is generally not supported.
items.translation: 默认实现会抛出 `TransactionSuspensionNotSupportedException`，假定事务挂起通常不受支持。

items.source:
The "SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY" is understood by Oracle, MySQL and Postgres
and may work with other databases as well. If you'd like to adapt this treatment,
override this method accordingly.
items.translation: "SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY" 被 Oracle、MySQL 和 Postgres 所支持，也可能适用于其他数据库。如果您希望调整此处理方式，请相应地重写此方法。

items.source: The returned object should contain information about any existing transaction, that is, a transaction that has already started before the current getTransaction call on the transaction manager. Consequently, a doGetTransaction implementation will usually look for an existing transaction and store corresponding state in the returned transaction object.
items.translation: 返回的对象应包含有关任何现有事务的信息，即在当前对事务管理器的 `getTransaction` 调用之前已经启动的事务。因此，`doGetTransaction` 的实现通常会查找现有事务，并将相应的状态存储在返回的事务对象中。

items.source: Called after doCommit and doRollback execution, on any outcome. The default implementation does nothing.
items.translation: 在 `doCommit` 和 `doRollback` 执行后，无论结果如何都会调用。默认实现什么都不做。

items.source: The default implementation returns false, assuming that participating in existing transactions is generally not supported. Subclasses are of course encouraged to provide such support.
items.translation: 默认实现返回 `false`，假设通常不支持参与现有事务。当然鼓励子类提供此类支持。

items.source: A special scenario is a nested transaction without savepoint: If useSavepointForNestedTransaction() returns "false", this method will be called to start a nested transaction when necessary. In such a context, there will be an active transaction: The implementation of this method has to detect this and start an appropriate nested transaction.
items.translation: 特殊场景是指不带保存点的嵌套事务：如果useSavepointForNestedTransaction()返回"false"，则会在必要时调用此方法以启动嵌套事务。在此类上下文中，将存在一个活动事务：此方法的实现必须检测这一点并启动适当的嵌套事务。

items.source:
This method allows the bean instance to perform validation of its overall
configuration and final initialization when all bean properties have been set.
items.translation: 此方法允许 Bean 实例在其所有属性设置完成后，执行其整体配置验证和最终初始化。

items.source:
The returned object will usually be specific to the concrete transaction
manager implementation, carrying corresponding transaction state in a
modifiable fashion. This object will be passed into the other template
methods (for example, doBegin and doCommit), either directly or as part of a
DefaultTransactionStatus instance.
items.translation: 返回的对象通常针对具体的事务管理器实现，以可修改的方式承载相应的事务状态。该对象将直接作为参数传入其他模板方法（例如 doBegin 和 doCommit），或者作为 DefaultTransactionStatus 实例的一部分传入。

items.source:
The result will be evaluated according to the specified propagation
behavior for the new transaction. An existing transaction might get
suspended (in case of PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW), or the new transaction
might participate in the existing one (in case of PROPAGATION_REQUIRED).
items.translation: 结果将根据新事务指定的传播行为进行评估。现有事务可能会被挂起（在 PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW 的情况下），或者新事务可能会参与现有事务（在 PROPAGATION_REQUIRED 的情况下）。

items.source:
This method gets called when the transaction manager has decided to actually
start a new transaction. Either there wasn't any transaction before, or the
previous transaction has been suspended.
items.translation: 此方法在事务管理器决定实际开始一个新事务时被调用。要么之前没有事务，要么之前的交易已被挂起。

items.source:
An implementation does not need to check the "new transaction" flag
or the rollback-only flag; this will already have been handled before.
Usually, a straight commit will be performed on the transaction object
contained in the passed-in status.
items.translation: 实现无需检查“新事务”标志或回滚专用标志；这些在此之前已经处理过。通常，将在传入状态中包含的事务对象上执行直接提交。
实现无需检查“新事务”标志；该标志此前已处理。通常，将对传入状态中包含的事务对象执行直接回滚。

items.source:
The default implementation throws an IllegalTransactionStateException,
assuming that participating in existing transactions is generally not
supported. Subclasses are of course encouraged to provide such support.
items.translation: 默认实现会抛出 `IllegalTransactionStateException`，假定参与现有事务通常不受支持。当然，鼓励子类提供此类支持。

items.source: Should not throw any exceptions but just issue warnings on errors.
items.translation: 不应抛出任何异常，而应在出错时仅发出警告。

items.source: Invoked by the containing BeanFactory after it has set all bean properties and satisfied BeanFactoryAware, ApplicationContextAware etc.
items.translation: 由包含的BeanFactory在设置所有 bean 属性并满足BeanFactoryAware、ApplicationContextAware等接口后调用。
